mapper.select: SELECT s.show_id AS showId, s.movie_id AS movieId, s.cinema_id AS cinemaId, s.hall_id AS hallId, s.start_time AS startTime, s.price AS basePrice, m.title AS movieTitle, c.name AS cinemaName, h.name AS hallName FROM show_schedule s INNER JOIN movie m ON m.movie_id = s.movie_id INNER JOIN cinema c ON c.cinema_id = s.cinema_id INNER JOIN hall h ON h.hall_id = s.hall_id WHERE s.show_id = #{showId}

SELECT seat.seat_id AS seatId, seat.zone AS zone, seat.seat_name AS seatName, COALESCE(zp.price, s.price) AS price FROM seat INNER JOIN show_schedule s ON s.seat_map_id = seat.seat_map_id LEFT JOIN show_zone_price zp ON zp.show_id = s.show_id AND UPPER(zp.zone) = UPPER(seat.zone) WHERE s.show_id = #{showId} AND seat.seat_id IN
#{id}
